import importlib.metadata, json, re, subprocess, sys, tomllib
from pathlib import Path

names = [
    "reprollm",
    "pytest",
    "pytest-cov",
    "coverage",
    "ruff",
    "mypy",
    "pydantic",
    "typer",
    "PyYAML",
    "respx",
    "jsonschema",
]
versions = {name: importlib.metadata.version(name) for name in names}
normalize = lambda name: re.sub(r"[-_.]+", "-", name).lower()
lock = tomllib.loads(Path("uv.lock").read_text())
pins = {normalize(p["name"]): p["version"] for p in lock["package"] if "version" in p}
assert versions["reprollm"] == "0.7.0"
assert all(versions[name] == pins[normalize(name)] for name in names if name != "reprollm"), (
    "locked tool version mismatch"
)
git = (
    subprocess.run(["git", "--version"], check=True, stdout=subprocess.PIPE).stdout.decode().strip()
)
uv = (
    subprocess.run([sys.argv[1], "--version"], check=True, stdout=subprocess.PIPE)
    .stdout.decode()
    .strip()
)
print(
    json.dumps(
        {
            "schema_version": 1,
            "python": sys.version.split()[0],
            "versions": versions,
            "git": git,
            "uv": uv,
            "tool_versions_match_uv_lock": True,
        },
        sort_keys=True,
    )
)

import hashlib, json, sys, zipfile
from pathlib import Path
from email.parser import BytesParser

target = Path(sys.argv[1])
wheels = list(target.glob("*.whl"))
assert len(wheels) == 1 and wheels[0].name == "reprollm-0.7.0-py3-none-any.whl", (
    "unexpected candidate wheel"
)
with zipfile.ZipFile(wheels[0]) as archive:
    names = archive.namelist()
    assert len(names) == len(set(names)), "duplicate wheel entry"
    expected = {
        "reprollm/" + p.relative_to(Path("src/reprollm")).as_posix(): p.read_bytes()
        for p in Path("src/reprollm").rglob("*")
        if p.is_file() and "__pycache__" not in p.parts and p.suffix != ".pyc"
    }
    actual = {
        name: archive.read(name)
        for name in names
        if name.startswith("reprollm/") and not name.endswith("/")
    }
    metadata = BytesParser().parsebytes(archive.read("reprollm-0.7.0.dist-info/METADATA"))
    equal = actual == expected and metadata["Version"] == "0.7.0"
print(
    json.dumps(
        {
            "schema_version": 1,
            "wheel_filename": wheels[0].name,
            "wheel_sha256": hashlib.sha256(wheels[0].read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
            "metadata_version": metadata["Version"],
            "all_package_file_set_and_bytes_match": equal,
            "package_file_count": len(expected),
            "payload_sha256": {k: hashlib.sha256(v).hexdigest() for k, v in actual.items()},
            "source_sha256": {k: hashlib.sha256(v).hexdigest() for k, v in expected.items()},
        },
        sort_keys=True,
    )
)
raise SystemExit(0 if equal else 1)
